scripts.build: yarn workspace @noot/shared build && yarn workspace @noot/engine-claude build && yarn workspace @noot/engine-cursor build && yarn workspace @noot/engine-lumo build && yarn workspace @noot/backend build && yarn workspace @noot/frontend build
scripts.dev: yarn workspace @noot/shared build && concurrently --names shared,backend,frontend "yarn workspace @noot/shared dev" "yarn workspace @noot/backend dev" "yarn workspace @noot/frontend dev"
scripts.test: yarn workspace @noot/shared build && yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude noot-v2 --parallel --topological run test
